question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

H _ K N _ Q T U W _ A _ F
solution:
The positional value of alphabet series is;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbf24f42e1d482898a5d5d143c7fb8549ccefbba7a5b4a3cb14456af03a4b016.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

**The difference between the alphabets must be +1,+2,+3 in the same order repeating itself.**

Now we consider the given options:

1) IPZC [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cb514bf00c194fdd26fc93dc995a8b74ab88a539845a13c8b77b18bfab690b2.png] 

**2) IOZC** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c71d3097b2c8c1745206848c63398dfd1d1f555259551f161dd7bbbd54e7be0d.png] 

3) IOYC [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0beb9a23b104b5273d1a04203aff2feaddc348e56d1ba335e2cd229602eb7470.png] 

4) JOZC [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59f6685d03e22ee6145ed75c5638657986cb2551c2cfff66fc9bed995f853c0f.png] 

Only option 2) follow the sequence.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
